resources.string: Before a sync replaces a save, on this device or on the server, Valkyr keeps a copy of what it replaces. For each save file the newest copies up to this number always stay; copies beyond it that are older than 30 days are moved to the recovery folder by a sync.

A sync replaces and deletes nothing. New saves travel both ways. A server save that changed is kept as a safety copy next to your device save (restore it from the game\'s cloud saves), a device save that changed is not sent over the server\'s, and deletions are not mirrored. Choosing a side in the conflict list still works.
When a save differs on both sides and the server\'s copy is clearly the newer one, the server\'s copy is taken without asking. Your device save is backed up first. Off: you choose each time.
Shows the backup copies beyond the number kept per save. Nothing moves before you confirm, and moved copies wait in the recovery folder for 14 days, so you can bring them back.
Nothing to prune: every save has %1$d backup copies or fewer.
%1$d backup copies (%2$s) are older than the newest %3$d of their save. They move to the recovery folder and can be brought back for 14 days.
The backups could not be read: %1$s
%1$d backup copies moved to the recovery folder.
%1$d backup copies from the last prune are in the recovery folder.
Keep both replaces nothing: the server version is saved as a safety copy on this device (restore it from the game\'s cloud saves) and both versions stay as they are until one changes again.
Slots of the same game. Copy one into another slot: you see what it replaces first, and the slot it replaces is backed up.
%1$s (%2$s, %3$s) will be copied into a new file, %4$s.
%1$s (%2$s, %3$s) will replace %4$s (%5$s, %6$s). The slot it replaces is backed up first, and the next sync sends the change to the server.
